text: The SIMATIC S7-1500S Software Controller brings SIMATIC S7-1500 controller functionality to industrial PCs for use with high-level languages like C++. This ensures high system availability and avoids downtimes because the controller runs even if the operating system fails or restarts. It uniquely combines the high reliability of a SIMATIC controller with the flexibility of a PC-based solution.
heading: Why SIMATIC S7-1500S?

text: Combine the high reliability and system availability of SIMATIC controllers with the advantages of PC-based solutions. Enjoy standardization, scalability, high uptime, simple PC application integration and high productivity.
heading: High performance

text: Benefit from the security of a PLC controller and from the flexibility and independence of an industrial PC. The SIMATIC software controller continues to run during restart or even when the operating system fails.
heading: Reliability

text: Enable a variety of applications, such as eMobility charging infrastructure or wind power generation. SIMATIC S7-1500 software controllers are versatile and reliable.
heading: Multiple applications

text: SIMATIC S7-1500S is the only software controller with integrated safety functions to protect the controller against manipulations and your intellectual property against unauthorized access – in one, user-friendly system.
heading: Integrated safety functions

text: Accelerate time-to-market, boost productivity and engineering efficiency, and gain greater flexibility with TIA Portal – your complete gateway to digitalized automation.
heading: Engineering with TIA Portal

text: Access a wide range of additional features like motion control, system diagnostics with a mouse click and much more. The SIMATIC S7-1500 software controller is also available in standard and fail-safe versions.
